governanceNote.en: Shri Gajanan Seva is governed by a volunteer board of trustees. The board meets quarterly and is responsible for finances, programme direction and safeguarding. Trustee names, roles and the governance policy are being prepared for publication.
governanceNote.mr: श्री गजानन सेवा स्वयंसेवी विश्वस्त मंडळामार्फत चालविली जाते.

description.en: Leads the daily and monthly upasana, maintains the seva timetable and trains new devotees in the order of the aartis.
Plans, cooks and serves mahaprasad at every upasana and utsav, and runs the kitchen during seva drives.
Coordinates the food, blanket, clothing, school supply, toy and hygiene kit drives with partner organisations.
Decoration, palkhi, cultural programme, sound and stage for the three major utsav of the year.
Runs the high school service-hours programme — logistics, crowd management, food service coordination, supply chain and administrative seva.
Newsletter, website, WhatsApp channel, photography and the YouTube recordings.
